tabs.label: Skip the setup, start dictating
tabs.body: No voice profile, no warmup, no setup you'll later feel locked in by. Ready from your first visit, in 90+ languages.

tabs.label: You don't need to speak perfectly
tabs.body: Nobody should have to say the word "comma" out loud. Speak the way you'd speak to a colleague and Heidi punctuates, formats and cleans it up as you go.

tabs.label: It gets better while you use it
tabs.body: Teach it a drug name once and it sticks. Same for your abbreviations, your shorthand, the colleagues you refer to. Right every time after that.
